articles.title: The Year AI Science and the Physical AI Industry Came Alive
articles.content:
我意识到，物理AI、具身AI和机器人技术将成为下一个大趋势，可能会被硅谷用来延续AI泡沫。四家主要的人形机器人公司——其中两家来自中国，一家来自美国，一家来自韩国——正在准备IPO。根据欧洲科技新闻网站Sifted（类似于欧洲的TechCrunch）的报道，今年上半年欧洲机器人初创公司的融资额已经超过过去两年的总和。这表明我们正进入一个新的自动化和机器人时代。

我刚刚深入研究了如何通过股市提前参与这一趋势的最佳方式。

昨天，我们得知谷歌AI领导层将迎来永久性变革。谷歌DeepMind的角色也在发生变化。杰夫·迪恩（Jeff Dean），这位长期担任首席科学家的人物，在27年后离开，创立了自己的公司Discovery Loop。利用AI进行科学研究正成为新风尚，而资本似乎不会成为实现未来的限制因素。

尽管AI尚未彻底改变科学，人形机器人也还未能在社会中发挥作用，但谷歌DeepMind的CEO德米斯·哈萨比斯（Demis Hassabis）将卸任CEO职位，转任该业务单元主席，并担任Alphabet的首席科学家。今年夏天，最引人注目的事或许是所有的物理AI种子轮融资、新公司和新交易，以及大量资本的涌入。一场机器人技术的攻势即将来临，而计算成本也将大幅增加。

GR 2是谷歌最先进的VLA模型，能够智能控制各种类型的机器人，从双臂机器人到完整的人形机器人。谷歌声称，这一智能层正在推动下一代真正可适应的机器人的发展。随着它迈出第一步，这一重大进步解锁了智能全身控制、高级灵巧性和多机器人协作。这可以被视为机器人的多模态层，这个2.0生态系统结合了视觉感知、空间推理和实时运动控制，所有这些都在一个单一的模型套件下实现。

在未来五年内，机器人的AI和软件脑必须有很大的进步，才能实现自主世界的在线化，而这也必然会实现。在自动驾驶领域，未来十年也将是关键时期，Waymo、Uber、百度、Wayve等公司将快速发展。我们需要强大的世界模型和专门为物理AI设计的大语言模型，而这些目前尚不存在，使人形机器人达到通用目的的实用性，GR 2在这一方向上迈出了大胆的一步。

中国机器人制造商Unitree Technology预计在其上海IPO后估值将超过500亿元人民币（约合74亿美元），这标志着中国在机器人市场上率先进入并占据主导地位，具有显著的成本优势。7月28日，特朗普政府在FCC的领导下宣布禁止进口外国制造的机器人。需要注意的是，中国有两家领先的机器人公司正在准备IPO。同时，根据Counterpoint的数据，中国的Agibot、Unitree和UBTech公司去年在人形机器人安装市场份额中排名前三，特斯拉的Optimus排名第五。IPO、SPAC（敏捷机器人）和禁令意味着机器人即将进入黄金时代。

articles.summary:
I’m coming to the realization that Physical AI, embodied AI and robotics is going to become a big deal. It’s going to be part of the Silicon Valley playbook to prolong the AI bubble. Four major humanoid robotics companies, two in China, one in the U.S. and one in South Korea, are going IPO. European robotics startups reportedly raised more capital in the first six months of this year than in the past two years combined, according to Sifted, which is a bit like the TechCrunch of Europe. What this implies is we are entering a new era of automation and robotics.

I just finished a deep dive into one of the best ways to get early stock market exposure to this trend here.

Deep Dive on Agility

Yesterday we learned that Google’s AI leadership is changing forever. Google DeepMind’s roles are changing. Jeff Dean, the longtime chief scientist, is leaving after 27 years to start his own company called Discovery Loop. Leveraging AI for science is now in vogue, and capital does not appear to be a limit in how we achieve the future.

While AI hasn’t yet transformed science and humanoid robots are not functional in society yet, Demis Hassabis is leaving his role as CEO of Google DeepMind to be the unit's Chairman. New roles: Chair of Google DeepMind & Chief Scientist of Alphabet. What’s caught my attention this summer perhaps the most is all the Physical AI seed rounds, new companies and new deals with so much more capital. There’s a robotics blitz coming, just as compute will get much more expensive.

Google Gemini Robotics 2

GR 2 is Google’s most advanced VLA model: capable of intelligently controlling any type of robot, from bi-arms to full humanoids. This is their intelligence layer, Google claims, is powering the next generation of truly adaptable robots. As it takes its first literal steps, this major advance unlocks intelligent whole-body control, advanced dexterity, and multi-robot collaboration. Think of this as a Multi-modal layer for the future of robotics, where this 2.0 ecosystem combines visual perception, spatial reasoning, and real-time motor control across an entire physical frame under a single model suite.

The AI and software brains of robotics is going to have to get much better in the next five years to bring this world of autonomy online, and it will. In autonomous vehicles the next decade is also pivotal with Waymo, Uber, Baidu, Wayve and others set to evolve fast. We will need strong world Models and specialized LLMs for Physical AI that don’t yet exist for humanoids to reach general purpose utility and GR 2 is a bold step in that direction.

Unitree Goes IPO

Chinese robot maker Unitree Technology is expected to be ​valued at more than 50 billion yuan ($7.4 billion) after ‌its planned Shanghai IPO and it marks a time where China is first to market and has a dominant marketshare in robotics with a significant cost advantage. On July 28th, The Trump administration under the FCC, announced a ban on future foreign made robots. For reference, two of China’s leaders are going IPO. Meanwhile Chinese companies Agibot, Unitree and UBTech accounted for the top-three humanoid companies by installation market share last year, according to Counterpoint. Tesla’s Optimus ranked fifth. The IPOs, SPACs (Agility) and Bans means robots are about to hit the prime time.
